name: Bergen Open 2015

venue.name: [Torgallmenningen if the weather is nice, otherwise at Nordnes bydelshus.](https://goo.gl/maps/tQCiQ)

information: The competition is a organized as a part of the Bergen board game festival. If the weather is good, the competition will be held outside, at Torgallmenningen in Bergen. Otherwise, it will be at Nordnes Bydelshus which is nearby.
